The '''2022 Copa Sudamericana final stages''' were played from 28 June to 1 October 2022.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/futbol-internacional/libertadores/calendario-libertadores-sudamericana-2022_0_pfbOeTQat.html|title=El calendario de la Libertadores y la Sudamericana 2022|work=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]]|date=17 August 2021|access-date=17 May 2022}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/documentos/manual-de-clubes-reglamento-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> with the final played in [[Córdoba, Argentina]] at the [[Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/cordoba-sera-una-fiesta-con-la-final-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Córdoba será una fiesta con la Final de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|trans-title=Córdoba will be a party with the 2022 CONMEBOL Sudamericana Final|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=23 June 2022|access-date=23 June 2022}}</ref>

==Qualified teams==
The winners of each of the eight groups in the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana group stage|Copa Sudamericana group stage]] as well as the third-placed teams of each of the eight groups in the [[2022 Copa Libertadores group stage|Copa Libertadores group stage]] advanced to the round of 16.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams play a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3). If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).
*The final is played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.6). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.5).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 27 May 2022, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]) at the CONMEBOL Convention Center in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Final stages draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/se-viene-el-sorteo-de-los-octavos-de-final/ |title=Se viene el sorteo de los Octavos de Final|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=23 May 2022|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/duelos-parejos-en-octavos-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana/|title=Duelos parejos en octavos de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 May 2022|language=es}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a Copa Sudamericana group winner (Pot 1) and a Copa Libertadores group third-placed team (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />

==Semi-finals==
The first legs were played on 31 August and 1 September, and the second legs were played on 7 and 8 September 2022.<ref name="SF_fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-las-semifinales-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Fixture de las Semifinales de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=12 August 2022|language=es}}</ref><ref name="SF_fixture_pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Fixture-Sudamericana-SEMIFINALES-1.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - SEMIFINALES|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=12 August 2022|language=es}}</ref>
